greeting.subject: You
greeting.subtext: Take the Spiritual Gift Test and uncover how you were designed to serve.

description.heading: Discover Your Gifts, Live with Purpose.
description.subheading: Everyone has a unique gift. Learn to understand it, nurture it, and use it to make a difference.

pillar1.title: Learn
pillar1.text: Deepen your understanding of who you are and what makes you unique through study and reflection.

pillar2.title: Grow
pillar2.text: Cultivate your talents, strengthen your faith, and develop the character to live your calling.

pillar3.title: Serve
pillar3.text: Use your gifts to impact others, build community, and reflect compassion through action.

callToAction.subtext: Take the Spiritual Gift Test today and embark on a journey of self-discovery and purpose.
